MOBILE PLAY GUIDE ↗CALIBRATION · MOTION PERMISSION · TOUCH FALLBACK

Mobile installation uses your browser’s install or Add to Home Screen feature. It is an installable web app, not an APK or App Store release. Wait for “Offline ready” before disconnecting.

BEFORE THE GREEN LIGHT

Good to know.

How do I play?

WASD or arrow keys to drive. Space to drift, Shift to boost, F to fire, E for missiles, and X for your signature ability. Touch controls appear on mobile. The garage includes a full guide.

Will it run on my device?

Use an up-to-date browser with WebGL enabled. Start with Performance graphics on mobile or older computers. Landscape orientation gives touch controls more space. Actual frame rate depends on your device.

Can I play without internet?

Installed mobile solo modes work after the game is saved offline. Visit online and wait for the offline-ready message before leaving. Browser storage may be removed by your device, so reconnect if assets are missing.

Where is my progress saved?

Your career and settings stay in this browser on this device. There is no account or cloud save. Clearing browser data removes them. Credits are a career score; all vehicles and paints are already unlocked.

How do LAN rooms work?

A host runs npm ci and npm start from the game repository on a computer with Node.js 22 or newer. Open the address shown in the instructions. Every driver must use the same server. The host selects the circuit and starts the match.

Install TEJAX KART

Android: Open this website in Chrome. Tap its menu, then “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

iPhone / iPad: Open in Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

Desktop: Open the game and play directly in your browser.

After installing on mobile, open the garage settings, enable tilt, and calibrate. Open the game once online and wait for the offline-ready message before playing without internet.
